**Overview**  
  

At WakeMed, our mission is to improve the health and well-being of our community—and we do it by delivering outstanding, compassionate care.

We're seeking a **Clinical Performance Data Analyst** to transform complex clinical data into meaningful insights that help drive better patient outcomes and organizational performance. In this role, you will serve as a trusted partner to clinical and operational leaders, leveraging advanced analytics, data visualization, and healthcare expertise to support data-driven decision making across the health system. You'll act as a bridge between data sources, reporting teams, and business stakeholders while providing expert analysis of clinical performance data.

**What You'll Do**  
    • Analyze complex clinical and operational data from multiple sources using tools such as SQL, SAS, and data warehouse technologies to identify trends, opportunities, and performance insights.  
    • Develop interactive dashboards, visualizations, and reports using Tableau and other analytics tools to communicate findings to clinical and operational leaders.  
    • Serve as a subject matter expert on clinical quality measures, disease states, CMS-focused populations, and hospital care processes, connecting data insights to patient outcomes and organizational goals.  
    • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to support strategic, clinical, and performance improvement initiatives through advanced statistical and analytical methodologies.

    • Minimum of 3 years of experience in data analytics and reporting within an information technology, healthcare analytics, or related environment.

    • Strong analytical and technical skills with experience using SQL, data visualization tools, and advanced analytics platforms such as SAS.  
    • Healthcare experience, particularly within an acute care environment, is preferred.  
    • Professional certifications such as Epic Certification, Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), or other relevant clinical or analytics certifications are a plus.

General Job Summary:
The Analytic Engineer is responsible for applying their deep domain expertise in healthcare and analytics to improve decisions that strengthen patient care, support clinicians, and improve business outcomes across Tryon Management Group.
This is an individual-contributor role for an analyst who has spent a career inside healthcare data, knows athenaNet inside and out, and is energized by the work of building the dashboards, reports, and underlying datasets that the rest of the organization relies on every day. You will work at the intersection of revenue cycle, clinical operations, and executive strategy, and you will help define how analytics gets done here as the function grows. The scope of this role extends from raw data to dashboards, with plenty of data analysis along the way.
Primary Job Responsibilities:

• Partner directly with business leaders, practice operators, and clinicians to scope ambiguous questions, design the right analysis, and deliver clear, defensible answers.

• Build the data assets — curated tables, derived metrics, and reusable models — that power the dashboards and reports our organization runs on.

• Develop and maintain executive- and operator-facing dashboards in Sigma, enabling leadership to self-serve on operational and financial performance instead of relying on bespoke spreadsheet work.

• Translate athenaNet's raw data — appointments, encounters, claims, charges, transactions, patient and provider entities — into trustworthy datasets that downstream consumers can actually use.

• Identify performance improvement opportunities across revenue cycle and clinical workflows, and translate findings into actionable recommendations for operators and executive leadership.

• Mentor people within the data team. Coach partners across business, operations, and clinical teams — raising analytical rigor, documentation, and data fluency across the organization.

• Set the standard for how analytics gets done at Tryon as the function grows.

• Other tasks as assigned.

Education and Experience:

• 6+ years of experience using healthcare data to answer business questions, with strong preference for candidates with deep revenue cycle management (RCM) and/or ambulatory clinical operations exposure.

• In-depth, hands-on knowledge of athenaNet's data model. Tryon runs on athenahealth, and we need an Analytic Engineer who can navigate that data on day one without a long ramp.

• Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production dashboards in Sigma Computing, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool.

• Advanced SQL (Snowflake and/or Oracle) and the ability to design data assets that are performant, well-modeled, and easy for downstream consumers to use.

• Experience with dbt preferred.

• A track record of working directly with senior business stakeholders — translating fuzzy strategic questions into specific analyses, and findings into decisions.

• Familiarity with value-based care, patient panel analytics, or independent physician group operations.

• Background in economics, statistics, or another quantitative discipline preferred.

Physical Requirements:

• Work consistently requires walking, standing, sitting, lifting, reaching, stooping, bending, pushing, and pulling.

• Must be able to lift and support weight of 35 pounds.

• Ability to concentrate on details.

• Use of computers for long periods of time.

This is a remote role that may only be hired in the following locations: (Charlotte, NC, Raleigh, NC or Phoenix, AZ)

## About This Role

Hearst Technology Services, Inc. (HTS) has an opportunity for a Cloud-focused Sr FinOps Data Analyst with experience analyzing costs and resource consumption of applications hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google (GCP) cloud IaaS and PaaS platforms. Hearst embraces modern, cloud-native approaches for our businesses.  This position reports to the Senior FinOps Manager of Hearst’s Cloud Center of Excellence.

The Sr FinOps Data Analyst will be responsible for providing monthly cost analysis and optimization opportunities for a collection of approximately 50 subsidiary business units.  The Sr FinOps Data Analyst will assist in maintaining the supporting cloud billing data as well as the front-end cost management toolset. They will analyze a portfolio of Hearst-owned businesses’ cloud consumption data and present insights to these internal customer businesses on a monthly basis.

We are looking for candidates who are highly analytical and detail-oriented, with strong communication skills.  Public cloud platform domain knowledge is a must.  Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential, along with a passion for research and discovery.  Experience with high-trust, self-organizing, multi-disciplinary teams and the workflows that support them is important.

## What You’ll Do

* Monitor, analyze, and report on cloud spend across Amazon Web Services, Azure, and Google Cloud environments
* Lead monthly cloud consumption and cost optimization business review meetings with Hearst-owned businesses
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports using SQL and cost management platforms (e.g., CloudHealth, Cloudability, Apptio) to track spend trends, budget variance, and forecast accuracy
* Identify cost optimization opportunities such as rightsizing, reserved instance/savings plan coverage, idle resource elimination, and storage tiering
* Partner with engineering teams to implement tagging strategies, cost allocation models, and showback/chargeback frameworks
* Support monthly and quarterly cloud spend reviews with business units and leadership
* Investigate cost anomalies and spend spikes, root-causing drivers and recommending corrective action
* Maintain and improve cost allocation logic, including tagging compliance and unallocated spend reduction
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis for cloud costs
* Assist in developing and refining FinOps policies, KPIs, and maturity roadmaps
* Stay current on cloud provider pricing models, discount programs, and new cost management tooling
* Track and analyze costs associated with AI/ML workloads, including GPU/accelerator utilization, model training and inference spend, and third-party LLM API usage (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI)
* Build visibility into AI cost drivers such as token consumption, request volume, model selection, and compute reservation vs. on-demand usage
* Partner with data science and engineering teams to right-size GPU instances, evaluate reserved vs. spot capacity for training jobs, and identify underutilized AI infrastructure
* Support forecasting and budgeting for AI initiatives, accounting for the variable and rapidly scaling nature of AI/ML spend

## What You’ll Bring

### Required Qualifications

* 6+ years of experience in FinOps, cloud cost management, financial analysis, or a related analytical role
* Proficiency in \*\*SQL\*\* for querying, transforming, and analyzing large datasets
* Hands-on experience with cloud cost management/optimization tools such as \*\*CloudHealth (VMware Aria Cost)\*\*, Cloudability, or native cloud billing tools (AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, GCP Billing)
* Solid understanding of cloud provider billing models, including reserved instances, savings plans, spot pricing, and committed use discounts
* Experience building Business Intelligence reports and dashboards (SQL-based BI tools, Excel, Tableau, Power BI, or Looker)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical cost data into business-relevant insights
* Familiarity with cloud tagging strategies and cost allocation frameworks
* Working knowledge of AI/ML cost drivers, including GPU/compute pricing, LLM API billing models (token- or request-based pricing), and cost differences across model providers and tiers

### Preferred Qualifications

* Microsoft Excel with advanced skills working with Pivot Tables and complex formulas
* Knowledge of FinOps principles (FinOps Foundation certification a plus)
* Experience monitoring AI/LLM usage and cost through platforms such as Anthropic Console, OpenAI usage dashboards, Azure AI cost management, or third-party AI cost tools
* Experience with business intelligence tools such as PowerBI or Tableau
* Strong statistics and algebra math skills
* Prior experience working directly with engineering teams on cost-aware architecture decisions
* Ability to read or write scripts in one or more modern scripting or programming languages: R, SQL, Python, Scala, Java, C++, Ruby, PowerShell, Go

### Educational Requirements

* BS/BA degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or relevant industry experience
* Cloud Certifications, optional
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification, or willingness to obtain

Hearst provides a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, 401(k), paid holidays and paid time off, employee assistance programs, and more.
